# aws-identity

IAM least privilege (wildcard grants, session duration) and Cognito pool posture (MFA, deletion protection) as measured by the iam-role/cognito dump readers.

## Recipes

- `apiforge knowledge show aws-identity`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-IAM-001, AF-IAM-002, AF-IAM-003, AF-IAM-004, AF-IAM-005
